extractedText: Privacy Coins Just Had Their Best Quarter in Years Here's what drove the sector in Q2 2026: $ZEC: surged over 73% after Multicoin Capital disclosed a large long position, Grayscale filed for a spot ETF conversion, and the shielded pool ratio crossed a historic 30% all-time high, closing with a clean SEC investigation $XMR: advanced FCMP++ for maximized anonymity sets, held consolidation near multi-year highs around $343, deployed a metadata obfuscation refactor to prevent IP-level tracking $ROSE: expanded the Oasis Privacy Layer for cross-chain confidential execution, launched institutional Data-DAO partnerships for health and financial data, disbursed $8.5M in developer grants $SCRT: upgraded IBC for encrypted messaging across Cosmos chains, refreshed TEE firmware against hardware side-channel attacks, released a Confidential AI Hub SDK $ZEN: fully migrated to an EVM-compatible L3 privacy appchain on Base, launched liquidity pools on Uniswap and Aerodrome, committed a 1M ZEN developer grant pool, reinforced its eToro listing $WLD: shipped World ID 3.0's full Proof of Human stack, finalized enterprise ID integrations with Zoom and DocuSign, released AgentKit for cryptographic human-verification by AI agents Midnight (Cardano ecosystem): launched its privacy-centric mainnet, completed regulated selective disclosure tooling for tax authorities, locked in logistics consortium pilots $XVG: deployed the MyVergies wallet with non-KYC cross-chain swaps across 2,000+ assets, refactored Tor/I2P routing, updated Wraith Protocol for regional compliance $ZANO: integrated multi-asset private issuance, partnered on a zero-knowledge algorithmic stablecoin framework, launched trustless escrow infrastructure for confidential commerce The through-line across all ten: privacy tech is being packaged for institutions and enterprises now, not just individual users looking to stay off-grid. $ZEC's institutional backing and ETF filing alone reframed the entire narrative from "regulatory risk" to "wealth protection."
